units.source_text: 女人鼻子里像盖着纸片似的打起了鼾……

en.t: The woman began to snore through her nose, as if it were covered with a slip of paper...

units.source_text: 呼吸又深又长，在她脚后跟轻轻踢了几下试试，几乎没有任何变化……

en.t: Her breathing was deep and long; even when he tried lightly kicking her heel a few times, there was almost no change...

units.source_text: 像是把情欲全挤榨干净的陈旧软管。

en.t: She was like an old soft tube from which every last trace of desire had been squeezed out.

units.source_text: 他把她脸上的手巾盖盖好，把裹在下腹绞得像绳子似的衣服，往膝盖上面拉了拉。

en.t: He straightened the towel over her face and tugged the clothes twisted like a rope around her lower belly up over her knees.

units.source_text: 幸好，计划直到最后都排得满满的，所以，也就没有工夫沉湎于感伤了。

en.t: Fortunately, the plan was packed full right up to the end, so there was no time to sink into sentimentality.

units.source_text: 早就准备好的旧剪刀，费了一番功夫终于弄了上去，预定时间也已经到了。

en.t: After some effort, he finally got the old scissors he had prepared long beforehand into place, and the appointed time had already arrived.

units.source_text: 临出门的最后一瞥，像被什么撕碎似的，他感到隐隐作痛。

en.t: At his last glance before leaving, he felt a dull ache, as if something inside him were being torn apart.
